content.text: 把压缩阈值调到 0.9,顺便 retainRatio 提到 0.3。
先对齐事实:thresholdRatio 0.9 意味着更晚压缩,溢出恢复要多兜底;retainRatio 0.3 在小窗口模型上会让 retainTokens 逼近 thresholdTokens。先看 packages/compaction/src/basic/config.ts 的校验、当前 .eterna/compaction.config.json,再跑包级 verify 验证。
packages/compaction/src/basic/config.ts: resolveCompactSpec — thresholdTokens = floor(min(W*ratio, W-reserved-headroom)); retainTokens >= thresholdTokens -> TargetPressureConfigError
.eterna/compaction.config.json: { "auto": true, "thresholdRatio": 0.8, "retainRatio": 0.16 }

$ pnpm --filter @eterna/compaction run verify
FAIL packages/compaction/tests/basic-config.spec.ts > TargetPressureConfigError: BasicCompactionConfig: retainTokens (34) must be less than threshold tokens (33)

retainRatio 0.3 rejected: TargetPressureConfigError retainTokens >= thresholdTokens in the 120-token window test — 0.3 在小窗口下直接过不了校验(pnpm --filter @eterna/compaction run verify 红)。0.9 的主要风险是把压缩负担推给溢出恢复。建议维持 thresholdRatio 0.8 / retainRatio 0.16,等你拍板。

那按你说的:阈值先不动保持 0.8,retainRatio 也维持。
把热更新白名单检查补上测试;另外模型切换报错——压缩失败抛的是什么错来着?
记录两条:模型切换报错时压缩失败抛 MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED(packages/compaction/src/basic/index.ts 的 agent/request prepend 监听);手动压缩撞上开 turn 时抛 ManualCompactionError(busy)。下面补热更新白名单测试,先看现有夹具。
packages/compaction/src/basic/index.ts: agent/request prepend listener — compactPressure(requireBelowThreshold=true) failure -> MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED
packages/compaction/tests/helpers/fakes.ts: makeFakeEngineContext exposes listenersOf/warns/setPruner; overrides file fixture pattern available
用 fakes 的 overrides 夹具补白名单外键忽略用例,写进 packages/compaction/tests/basic-hotreload.spec.ts,然后单独跑该 spec。
ok: packages/compaction/tests/basic-hotreload.spec.ts updated (whitelist-rejection case added, unknown key ignored, warns untouched)

$ pnpm vitest run tests/basic-hotreload.spec.ts
ok: 6 passed (whitelist-rejection included)

热更新白名单检查补上测试完成:packages/compaction/tests/basic-hotreload.spec.ts 新增白名单外键忽略用例,vitest 6 passed;packages/compaction/tests/basic-config.spec.ts 与 packages/compaction/tests/helpers/fakes.ts 未动。配置面再核对一遍 state 与 profile 冒烟。
.eterna/compaction.state.json: { "compactions": 3, "lastCompactionAt": 1762099200000 } (state read-only, untouched)

$ node scripts/verify-eterna-web.mjs
verify-eterna-web: PRESET_KEPT_ROWS unchanged; compaction rows present (basic/pruner/admin)
配置未动:.eterna/compaction.config.json 保持 auto/thresholdRatio 0.8/retainRatio 0.16;.eterna/compaction.state.json 只读核对;node scripts/verify-eterna-web.mjs 通过,PRESET_KEPT_ROWS 不变。
总结一下决策,写到 packages/compaction/evals/facts.ts 旁边的评估材料里;记住白名单不扩,三个键不变。

decision: thresholdRatio stays 0.8; 0.9 deferred — later compaction shifts more load onto overflow recovery;overrides whitelist unchanged: auto/thresholdRatio/retainRatio only; new keys require restart;MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED thrown by the agent/request prepend listener on switch compaction failure。按"白名单不扩,三个键不变"写进 packages/compaction/evals/facts.ts 旁的评估材料,供 golden 评分对照。
帮我再算一遍:不同 thresholdRatio × retainRatio 组合在 120 token 小窗口和 65536 实窗口下各是什么表现?算完把模拟表写进评估材料,别改配置。
只做纸面模拟,不动 .eterna/compaction.config.json(白名单不扩,三个键不变);用 resolveCompactSpec 的公式逐组合算 thresholdTokens/retainTokens,并把模拟表写进评估材料。

content.arguments: {"command":"node --input-type=module -e \"import {resolveCompactSpec} from './packages/compaction/src/basic/config.ts'; for (const t of [0.7,0.8,0.9]) for (const r of [0.12,0.16,0.3]) console.log(t, r)\""}
